story.iWant: purchase bills above a configurable threshold to require approval through a maker-checker workflow
story.soThat: high-value supplier payments are properly authorized and financial controls are maintained

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Approval threshold is admin-configurable (default 20M VND) 2. If bill exceeds threshold OR marked sensitive: auto-moves to 'Pending Approval' status 3. In-app notification (bell icon) and email notification to Chief Accountant (with backup/escalation after 48h/no action) 4. Approver ≠ creator enforced by system (database constraint + application logic) 5. Approver UI: Approve/Reject buttons (with reason mandatory on reject), all attachments/history shown 6. All workflow state transitions (draft→pending→posted/rejected) logged and visible in bill audit 7. On approval, mark "Posted by" as approver (not creator) 8. Approval after period close disabled; error on attempt, logged 9. If workflow not triggered (amount ≤ threshold AND not sensitive): auto-approve, logs shadow "auto-approved" record 10. All notification/rejection/status updates audit-logged

constraints.constraint: Multi-tenancy: All approval workflow operations must be company-scoped via CompanyScopedEntity and CompanyContext. Database queries filtered by company_id.
RBAC: Chief Accountant and CFO roles can approve/reject bills. Accountant role can only submit for approval. Use @PreAuthorize annotations for method-level security.
Database: Approver ≠ creator enforced at database constraint level (CHECK constraint) AND application logic in service layer.
Period Validation: Approval operations must respect period close rules. Bills cannot be approved if period is closed. Reuse PeriodManagementService for validation.
Threshold Configuration: Approval threshold stored in database configuration table (default 20M VND), configurable by Admin at runtime.
Notification Strategy: Dual notification system - in-app (primary) and email (secondary). Email failures must not block approval operations.
Audit Trail: All approval workflow state transitions logged with before/after snapshots, SHA-256 diff hash, user/timestamp/IP. Append-only, immutable.
Transaction Integrity: Approval operations wrapped in @Transactional with rollback on validation failures. Atomic workflow creation and bill status update.
Auto-Approval: Bills ≤ threshold AND not sensitive must auto-approve with shadow workflow record for audit trail (AC #9).

tests.standards: Follow testing patterns established in Story 4.1: Use TestContainers with PostgreSQL for integration tests. Mock external services (email) in unit tests. Test approval workflow state transitions comprehensively. Verify RBAC enforcement at all levels (service, controller, UI). Test approver ≠ creator constraint thoroughly. Validate notification sending and escalation logic. Backend: JUnit 5 + Mockito + AssertJ. Frontend: Vitest + Testing Library. Target: 70% coverage for service layer, critical flows for integration tests.

ideas.idea: Test approval threshold is configurable via admin settings. Verify default value is 20M VND. Test threshold changes apply immediately to new bills.
Test bills exceeding threshold auto-move to PENDING_APPROVAL status. Test sensitive flag triggers approval regardless of amount. Test bills ≤ threshold bypass workflow.
Test in-app notification sent to Chief Accountant on approval request. Test email notification sent via Resend service. Test escalation notification after 48h no action. Mock email service in tests.
Test approver = creator returns 400 error at service level. Test database CHECK constraint prevents same user approval. Test different users in same role can approve.
Test approve/reject buttons only visible to Chief Accountant/CFO roles. Test rejection requires mandatory reason. Test all attachments and history shown in approval UI.
Test workflow state transitions logged with before/after snapshots. Test SHA-256 diff hash calculated for each transition. Test audit timeline shows all events chronologically.
Test posted bill shows approver as "Posted by" not creator. Test voucher audit trail shows approver user. Test approval timestamp recorded correctly.
Test approval after period close returns validation error. Test approval blocked with clear error message. Test audit log records blocked attempt.
Test bills ≤ threshold auto-approve with shadow workflow record. Test auto-approval logged in audit trail. Test auto-approved bills skip notification.
Test all notification send attempts logged. Test rejection reason logged with timestamp. Test status updates logged with user/IP address.
